task: Metadata split eligibility only; stop if a credible separate final set cannot be established

domain.inputs: Zenodo record metadata, its README, linked upstream README, and prior development exposure record
domain.unit: Whole acquisition unit with source-backed session/segment membership; whole bags alone do not establish this grouping
domain.comparison: Descriptive filename/checksum census and source-provenance review; no model-performance threshold
domain.exclusions: Bag payloads, training fits, lateral fitting and final scoring are excluded until split eligibility is resolved

source_review.README: Each bag is described as a continuous run. No session identifiers, segment-parent mapping, end times, or vehicle/surface/configuration changes are supplied.
source_review.upstream_README: Links this dataset and explains loading/model use; supplies no file-to-acquisition-session mapping.
source_review.interpretation: Same-date filenames are a shared-session risk, not proof of common session membership. Distinct whole-file MD5 values do not exclude overlapping segments.
source_review.decision: No train/final roles assigned. Keep prior exposed bag as development; unopened bags remain unassigned together pending session provenance.

registration_limit: Metadata was inspected during prerequisite review before this registration. This record precedes the scripted census, not a blinded metadata decision. No additional bag outcomes have been opened.
downstream_protocol: Frame/time/causal-gap policies, emergency handling, longitudinal/lateral targets and model selection are not registered or executed because split eligibility failed first.
